conventions.money: Decimal strings in unspecified source currency; *_minor is amount x 100, not an asserted currency denomination.
conventions.quantity: Decimal strings, not binary floats; no is a separate multiplier, all source rows have no=1.
conventions.units: ft2=square feet; ft=running feet; each=count; point=source point; null=missing.
conventions.null: Unknown, not supplied or not applicable; never zero-filled.
conventions.authority: Original PDF > raw tables/text > reviewed JSON > generated exports and webpage.
conventions.scope: Estimate, not actual spend, procurement quantities, approval or a construction drawing.

issues.message: Source item numbers are duplicated: ['10']. Stable IDs use row order instead.
Source numbering skips [5, 13]; no missing line items were invented.
Detail total printed as 591770.9; sum of displayed item amounts is 591770.88; summary is 591770.88. Values are retained independently.
Source numbering skips [9, 11]; no missing line items were invented.
Source numbering skips [2, 6]; no missing line items were invented.
Detail total printed as 1964709; sum of displayed item amounts is 1964709.40; summary is 1964709.40. Values are retained independently.
Laminate Flooring appears on page 1 only; no quantities, rates or detailed scope are supplied.
Electrical Works appears on page 1 only; no quantities, rates or detailed scope are supplied.
Glass door is listed with zero quantity and zero amount; it is retained, not omitted.
Reception couch has a blank unit in the source; it remains null.
Unrounded product is 12721.875000; source amount is 12721.88. Two-decimal half-up result is 12721.88.
Currency is not stated anywhere in this PDF. NPR is plausible from project context, but has not been assigned as a source fact.
No estimate date or revision number is printed. The document ID uses the PDF creation day (2026-10-15), not an asserted estimate date.
Design and Supervision is an unpriced summary heading; no separate fee or inclusion/exclusion is inferred.
Summary SN 4 labels both Studio and Electrical Works.
AC capacity 1.5 MT and source spelling are preserved. MT has not been silently converted to ton.
Area details already include lighting and AC electrical works; the separate Electrical Works allowance has no breakdown. Confirm scope before interpreting this as duplication.
